description:
From the starting gate to the finish line, this bike is made for speed. With a race-ready frame, precision braking, and pro-inspired components, it’s built to handle intense competition and push limits. Whether hitting the track or perfecting new skills, every ride is an adrenaline rush.
Designed for control and speed, these grippy BMX tires deliver the perfect balance of traction and smooth rolling. Whether launching off jumps or taking tight corners, they keep riders locked in and race-ready.
Built for newer riders and future pros alike, this bike’s race-ready design is solid right out of the gate.With an upgradable platform featuring threaded European bottom bracket and 1-1/8” threadless headset, this bike is ready for the track.
A solid BMX ride starts with a strong front end. The four-bolt top load stem and 8.25” race handlebars deliver a secure, responsive feel, giving riders the confidence to take on jumps, turns, and sprints with precision.

components.description: Precision Braking for Control: Rear V-brake and alloy rims with grippy rubber tires ensure confident stops on the track.
